svg.title: Most tests need no network. Capacity is at the knee.
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Most tests need no network. Capacity is at the knee.” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A test pyramid with a wide base of unit tests at about 1 ms each, a middle band of TestClient endpoint tests at about 50 ms each, and a narrow top of contract and smoke tests against a deployment. Beside it, a plot of offered concurrency against throughput and p99 latency: throughput rises then flattens while p99 climbs steeply, and the crossing point is ringed and labelled THE KNEE. The average-latency curve is crossed out as useless. Below, /healthz and /readyz are separated, with one shared handler crossed out.
svg.text: Most tests need no network. Capacity is at the knee.
